title: Chats over several library papers
acceptance_criteria: Given a chat, when the user adds papers through the composer's @ picker at the start or mid-chat, then the chat includes up to five ready papers and lists them at the top.
Given a chat with several papers, when any of those papers is opened, then the chat appears in its chat list.
Given a question over several papers, when evidence is retrieved, then every included paper gets a fair share of the context and comparisons cite each relevant paper.
Given an answer citing several papers, when it renders, then each citation names its paper and page, and opening it switches the reader to that paper's PDF.
Given a citation to a document outside the chat's papers, when the answer is validated, then it fails as today.
Given a paper removed from a chat, when history is viewed, then earlier answers keep their citations, and the chat no longer appears under that paper.
Given existing single-paper chats, when the migration runs, then each becomes a one-paper chat with its pinned PDF and unchanged history.
Given a local model, when a multi-paper chat answers, then the input budget is shared across papers without exceeding it.
test_cases: Migration upgrade/backfill test from 0007 with existing chats.
Retrieval across documents with per-paper quotas and mixed embedding profiles.
Citation validation across chat documents; foreign documents rejected.
Frontend: multi-select picker, paper chips, cross-paper citation reader switch, chat listed under each paper.
verification: Ticketed on 2026-10-09 at the user's request. Not started; the user is deciding whether to add it.
